name: Okura Garden Hotel
detail: Okura Hotel stands out because of its staff . There are many five star hotels in Shanghai but their staff may not provide service which are comparable to the best . Our experience of staying in Okura makes us appreciate dedicated, sensitive and caring staff . When things go wrong the management is immediate at problem solving . We did not have to wait or get frustrated with our problems . Hotel facilities in all five star hotels in Shanghai are really good . However , if you want a hotel which looks after you throughout your stay and assist you with unexpected problems Okura fits the bill . We have stayed in Shanghai on and off for five years and tested quite a number of hotels .

name: The Kunlun Jing An
detail: We have stayed at Hilton on some of overseas trips and had mixed feelings when booking hotel at Shanghai based on review from previous guests. However, we thoroughly enjoyed our 4 day stay at this Hilton. - great location /walking distance near some prestigious department centres: Kerry Ann, Reel which are all linked together from basement. A good omen for the hot summer in July. We like the Ole supermarket and also the One in the basement of City Plaza ( opposite to Jing An temple). Good places to buy Chinese and import grocery. - hotel: clean standard room. Friendly/helpful staff/prompt service from Ms Rachel/IT support 24 hrs service/Laura from Housekeeping/Albert from the concierge whichis fully attended for any queries. - room service: exhausted from the heat and walking all over in Xintiandi and Tanzifang, we decided on room service and totally enjoyed the xiu long bao and Hainan chicken as well as the Chinese breakfast which is quite generous for one person to finish.
area: Jing'an and SHA Railway Station,Shanghai - View on map

name: Campanile Hotel - Shanghai Jing'an Temple
detail: I have not written a hotel review for a long time although I have been staying in hotels more in the past year. It's mainly because I have not came across anything new or interesting that intrigues me until my recent stay here. As you entered the hotel, you feel like you're at a chic hipster cafe. There are plenty of co-working, playing and dining spaces that are not only well-decorated but also functional. The same goes with their bed and shower rooms. I really love the colourful, urban decor which also gives a cozy homey feeling. I stayed at a much more expensive hotel the next day but Campanile offered what looked like better value for money in terms of the complimentary toiletry products and the pack of fantastic French butter cookies they provide to guests. The reception staff were friendly, pleasant and helpful. Honestly, I haven't been stimulated by the environment surrounding a hotel for a long time. I would stay here without any hesitation if I visit Shanghai again.
area: Jing'an and SHA Railway Station,Shanghai - View on map

name: URSIDE Hotel Shanghai South Bund
detail: The booked room is on the first floor lobby, the room is small but fully equipped with free snacks. The bed is comfortable and has a projector like a private cinema. The dinner in the lobby is delicious! Next door to the Power Station of Art, it is very convenient to see the exhibition. It is about 15 minutes walk from the subway station. However, because the room is on the first floor lobby, the sound and privacy will be slightly worse, but it is still very interesting!

name: Dorsett Shanghai @ Century Park
detail: The Yue Hotel is good value for money if you are coming with a family. My family of five stayed a total of three nights with three in one room and two in the other. The morning breakfast is a real plus with an excellent selection of food at the buffet. The hotel has easy access to Century Park, nearby Kerry Parkside Mall, (a little overpriced for Shanghai), The metro is directly underneath the hotel, and there is a really great cheap supermarket across the road. Ten minutes by taxi and you are at AP Plaza great for fake brand shopping. The Bund is within easy reach and the airport is about 45 minutes (130 yuan) or thr Maglev station is less than 10 minutes away by taxi or subway. There are some pretty crappy hotels in Shanghai and we made the mistake of staying at one once. The price was not far different but it was in a different league completely. One thing to note is that the wifi is available in the lobby not in the rooms. Lan cables are available in the rooms. Well worth your money, with or without the breakfast. We have no complaints. Speak slow and simply with the staff in English. It works out better.
area: Lujiazui and New Int'l Expo Center Pudong,Shanghai - View on map

name: Grand Hyatt Shanghai
detail: There are many luxury hotels in Shanghai and Grand Hyatt Shanghai may not be the one newest, but oh how wonderful their customer service was! I arrived deadly tired at midnight and the receptionist immediately took care of me, offering a complimentary breakfast and room with preferred bed size so that I could rest and enjoy the rest of stay with them. I was able to enjoy their morning exercise class and taste their beautifully crafted chocolate. I will definitely recommend this hotel to all business travellers who need a nice couple of nights to relax.
area: Lujiazui and New Int'l Expo Center Pudong,Shanghai - View on map

name: Cordis Shanghai Hongqiao
detail: Great hotel at good price for its quality. It's very close to Hongqiao Airport T2 and Hongqiao Train Station. You can walk to both from the hotel but be aware it's not signed well and few locals in the area speak English to ask directions! If you are flying into T1, it is quite challenging getting to T2. There is a Metro line underneath (only one stop) but you have to fully leave airport to get it (they is no internal route inside the airport, which is somewhat unusual for an airport!). I was told there was a bus every 30 mins between terminals but I couldn't find it so ended up getting a taxi around the airport at a cost of RMB55. There is a shopping mall very close the the hotel called the HUB, which also has a food court in basement. Only other thing to point out is this whole area is quite new, so I had trouble getting taxi's back to the hotel as they didn't know where it was. make sure you have the address written clearly in Chinese, ideally with a map if you go out.
area: Hongqiao Airport and National Convention Center,Shanghai - View on map
